# Dutch playable lexicon expanded from hunspell nl_NL / OpenTaal (LibreOffice dictionaries nl_NL @ 75f5dff8c972fff4a32e4ea8434722c277f02a3f).
# Two edition rules are applied, so this file lists playable TILE SEQUENCES rather than
# Dutch orthography:
#   1. the IJ ligature is written as 'ij', because the modern Dutch edition dropped its
#      IJ tile in 1998 and spells the sound with an I tile and a J tile;
#   2. diacritics are folded to their base letter, because no tile bears one.
# So 'ijs' and 'reeel' are here; the ligature and diaeresis spellings are not.
# Not an official tournament list.
